purpose: full prespecified replacement of all 400 core queries after four internal/external clock discrepancies in first session; keep original results as diagnostics
solver_seed: fixed at the source instance seed for every repeat
order: repeat-major; cases shuffled by random.Random(20261030+repeat); methods alternate by repeat+case rank
statistics: per-instance completions out of 10; query-time median/IQR includes censored calls; gap median/max; repeats are not new independent instances
concurrency: sequential queries; no concurrent document builds or other benchmarks launched by this task
timing_validation: process-scoped caffeinate -i; record time.time and perf_counter around every query; require solver_seconds <= external_monotonic_seconds + 0.1 and abs(realtime_seconds-external_monotonic_seconds)<=0.1
